_doc: TNPCB industry_type code -> the sector toggle it joins on the krishnagiri-rivers map.
The register (TNGIS generic_viewer:industry_cad_matched) prints each unit's type as
'<code>/<description>'. Sector is read from the CODE, never from a text match on the
name or description. Krishnagiri's register is stone and engineering country: granite
cutting (3068), quarries (1085), stone crushers (2064) and M-sand (2098) are the four
largest types, and metal surface treatment (1044) is the largest Red process type. The
national codes Erode's lookup carries (textile, tannery, paper, chemicals, treatment
plants) are kept so a unit of those types is classed the same way on both maps.
Codes not listed here fall to the category's general toggle; nothing is dropped.
'treatment' rules leave the industry layer and join the treatment-plants layer.

review.extractedBy: read from the distinct type strings in the Krishnagiri slice of the register, 2026-09-18 (1,695 units); Erode's national codes carried over

sectors.stone: Stone, granite and M-sand (cutting, polishing, crushing)
sectors.engineering: Engineering, fabrication and metal (furnaces, forging, casting)
